content.text: Gumroad's payout schedule means you wait a week or a month to access money you already earned. PayPal's conversion rates take 3 to 5 percent of every international transfer. Wire transfers cost $20 to $50 each way and take three to seven business days. These are not small frictions — they are structural extraction from creators already operating in harder markets. USDT on Tron eliminates all of this. Settlement in under 60 seconds. Fee under $0.10. The full USD equivalent of your product price lands in your wallet the moment the on-chain transaction confirms. No manual verification. No waiting. P2P conversion to local currency at near-market rates completes the pipeline — typically within 30 minutes of the original sale.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The combination of NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers provides a robust infrastructure for digital creators to receive payments without being tied to any specific platform. With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron, which costs under $0.10 per transaction in network fees. This decentralized approach ensures that you have full control over your payments and are not subject to the whims of traditional payment gateways.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your NOWPayments webhook with Cloudflare Workers, you need to have a few things in place. First, you need to create a NOWPayments account and obtain your API keys. You also need to set up a Cloudflare Workers account and have a basic understanding of how to write and deploy Workers scripts. Additionally, you need to have a digital product ready to sell and a way to deliver it to your customers.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline involves several steps. First, you need to create a new Worker in Cloudflare and add the necessary code to handle incoming payments. You then need to configure your NOWPayments account to send webhooks to your Worker, which will trigger the payment processing script. Finally, you need to set up a delivery mechanism, such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, to deliver your digital products to customers.
Decentralized payment processing gives you full control over your finances.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you have set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you can go live and start processing transactions. When a customer makes a payment, NOWPayments will send a webhook to your Cloudflare Worker, which will trigger the payment processing script. The script will then verify the payment and deliver the digital product to the customer. With Solana transaction fees averaging fractions of a cent per transaction, you can be sure that your payment processing costs will be minimal.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your business grows, you may need to scale your infrastructure to handle increased traffic and sales. With Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments, scaling is easy. You can simply increase the number of Workers you have running, or upgrade to a more powerful plan. Additionally, you can use the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) to deploy a fully functional e-commerce stack, complete with SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and end-to-end testing, in just 48 hours.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

Getting paid in crypto is operationally simpler than it appears. You configure your wallet address in NOWPayments once — this takes under 30 minutes. From that point, every sale deposits automatically into your wallet without any action required from you. The transaction hash in your order log is cryptographic proof of every payment. When you want to convert to local currency, you transfer USDT from your wallet to your exchange account and post a P2P sell order. The buyer sends local currency to your bank account or mobile money account and you release the USDT. Most P2P transactions complete in under 30 minutes.
USDT on Tron costs under $0.10 per transaction in network fees.

If you're looking for a comprehensive solution to deploy your digital products and start accepting crypto payments, check out the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This stack includes everything you need to get started, including Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, all configured and tested for you.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your NOWPayments webhook with Cloudflare Workers, follow these steps: create a NOWPayments account and obtain your API keys, set up a Cloudflare Workers account, write and deploy a Worker script to handle incoming payments, configure your NOWPayments account to send webhooks to your Worker, set up a delivery mechanism such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, and test your payment processing pipeline to ensure everything is working correctly.

Yes, you can use Cloudflare Workers with other payment gateways, but NOWPayments is a popular choice due to its decentralized nature and low fees.
